svg.text: Seed3 socket (jumper ends in the right wall), seen from INSIDE, USB-C end on your LEFT
PG-1 wiring, page 7 of 10: The ground chain (one black wire, part to part)
Solder a short black wire from each lug to the next, in the order of the steps. The last one (from the screen's GND) is SPLICED onto the jumper from
the board's 'gnd' to Seed3 place 40, about 3 cm from the socket: strip 5 mm of that jumper, wrap, solder, heat shrink (a socket place holds only one
Steps (the number is on the wire):
pg-1: C (MIDDLE pin of the row of 3) -> pg-1: push 2
pg-1: push 2 (RIGHT pin of the 2) -> pg-2: C (MIDDLE
pg-2: C (MIDDLE pin of the row of 3) -> pg-2: push 2
pg-2: push 2 (RIGHT pin of the 2) -> pg-3: C (MIDDLE
pg-3: C (MIDDLE pin of the row of 3) -> pg-3: push 2
pg-3: push 2 (RIGHT pin of the 2) -> pg-4: C (MIDDLE
pg-4: C (MIDDLE pin of the row of 3) -> pg-4: push 2
pg-4: push 2 (RIGHT pin of the 2) -> pg-a: the other lug
pg-a: the other lug -> pg-b: the other lug
pg-b: the other lug -> pg-c: the other lug
pg-c: the other lug -> screen: pin 2 'GND' (printed on
the module) (ground chain (screen GND: cut a jumper,
solder its cut end in the chain))
screen: pin 2 'GND' (printed on the module) -> Seed3
socket place 40 (bottom row) (chain's end: SPLICED onto
the j10.gnd -> seed.40 jumper, 3 cm from the socket
(strip 5 mm, wrap, solder, heat shrink). A socket place
